name: io-tax-scope-reference
description: British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT, Diego Garcia) reference for reviewers assessing the territorial reach of selected tax and employer provisions in 2026. Covers the Taxation Ordinance 1981 s3 restriction on income tax, corporation tax and capital gains tax imposed through preserved law, the Companies Ordinance 1981 s3 residence rule, and the Employment Ordinance 1984 conditions (employer of 10 or more employees, Crown and government exclusion, insurance, medical care and repatriation duties), all in the revised edition stating the law as at 1 September 2020. Trigger on BIOT, Diego Garcia, territorial income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax or contractor employment. Supplies no liability, filing position, general tax exemption or professional sign-off.
